This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Hollywood and video games make shooting a gun sideways look cool, but is it actually a good idea? Popularized by movies and games like GTA San Andreas, the infamous "gangsta grip" comes with some serious drawbacks! Poor sight alignment, reduced accuracy, awkward recoil, and even potential firearm malfunctions. Turns out, looking cool doesn't help you hit your target!

title: Why Shooting a Gun SIDEWAYS Is a Terrible Idea!
